prompt:
Build a fresh, original national statistics site for Indonesia — "NusaData: Statistik Indonesia" — for the make.fun competition best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539 ($50, top 10 share, free entry, judge AI pairwise by win rate). Deadline 29 Nov 12:39 WIB. Transcript gate ON: bundle with --muse-usage later by the orchestrator.

CONTEXT — WHY A FRESH BUILD: an earlier entry in this same competition (submission 01a2170c, repo hermansto/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539-v2) is scored with all checks passing but ranked only 2999 of 6501 in blind round 3 (score 533211, down from 2932nd in round 2). This fresh build must clearly beat it on presentation, data depth, and usability. Latest entry counts. NEVER open, read, or copy the old repo, the old build directories, or any earlier entry files — own-work rule: write every line fresh in this session. The only facts you may reuse from the old entry, as prose: it was an Indonesia statistics site; its mount-bug fix (never delete the output directory itself, only its children); d3 may be vendored as a single *.min.js.

SPEC (from the task card — follow it exactly):
- app/ holds static files, no build step. app/index.html opens in desktop Chrome and on a phone from its own files with ZERO network requests. main.ts at repo root copies app/ + screenshots/ to $MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR and writes /output/dossier.json with buildDossier from vendor/makefun-frontend.ts. vendor/makefun-frontend.ts stays UNTOUCHED. main.ts is Node 22, stdlib only. main.ts must NEVER delete the output directory itself — delete only known children (app/, screenshots/, dossier.json) or nothing (the grader mounts /output; deleting the dir itself fails there but passes locally).
- Caps: app/ at most 993 files+dirs and 16 MiB total; app/index.html at most 1 MiB; /output at most 1000 entries and 64 MiB; dossier.json at most 1.5 MiB and byte-identical to buildDossier output.
- Screenshots: 3–4 images, first by name = cover. Each PNG or JPEG, at most 256 KiB, long side at most 1280 px, short side at least 360 px. Real renders of this site's own code in a browser, unedited, uncomposited. Include one phone-size frame (short side >= 360).
- LICENSE: MIT, first line `SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT`, at repo root.
- README.md: exactly 3 LINKED make.fun badges — https://make.fun/badge/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539.svg, https://make.fun/badge/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539/hermansto/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539-v2/rank.svg, https://make.fun/badge/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539/hermansto/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539-v2/reward.svg — each linked to https://make.fun/bounty/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539.
- makefun-run.json at repo root contains this brief verbatim as the opening prompt.
- Repo for upload: https://github.com/hermansto/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539-v2 (created 2026-11-26T07:18:56Z, after opensAt 2026-11-26T05:39:00Z). New commit on that repo. GitHub About = bounty URL + topic makefun (orchestrator verifies).

THE DATA: TRAP — READ CAREFULLY. In this competition, `data:` URIs are allowed ONLY for fonts (@font-face url() or font preload). Scripts, modules, stylesheets, @import, frames, modulepreload, and import-map values as `data:` are REJECTED. NO external origin at all — not one http:// or https:// URL anywhere in app/, including make.fun itself. Every script, stylesheet, font, and image is a plain file inside app/. This is the OPPOSITE of the game/ competitions that allow data: everywhere — do not bring that habit here.

CHARTS: hand-rolled SVG/CSS charts are preferred (zero library weight, zero reproduces risk). If you use d3 7.9.2, vendor it ONLY as a single *.min.js file (or under a vendor/ directory) — any other vendoring makes library lines count against thinking_reproduces. No other libraries.

CONTENT — INDONESIA, REAL BPS NUMBERS ONLY (researcher must verify each number against a real source; no invented figures):
- Hero KPIs: population (~283 juta, 2024), GDP (~Rp 22.000+ triliun / ~US$1,4 triliun, 2024), economic growth (~5,0–5,2%), inflation (~1,5–2,5%), unemployment (~4,9%), poverty rate (~9%).
- Sections, each reachable by link: Overview (KPIs), Economy (GDP + growth chart over years, inflation, sectors), People (population by province top 10, age structure, urbanisation), Work (unemployment by province, labour force), Prices & Poverty, Provinces explorer (searchable/sortable table of 38 provinces with population + GRDP), Sources & methods (every number cites BPS / Bank Indonesia / Ministry of Finance with year).
- Every control must work as labelled; nothing empty, broken, or placeholder. Sortable tables, working tabs/filters, a working search. Mobile layout must be clean (no horizontal overflow at 390 px).
- Design: clean official-statistics-portal look — white/paper background, deep navy + BPS-red accents, readable at a glance, charts with labelled axes and units. Dense but organised; the judge compares screenshots pairwise, so the cover shot must show hero KPIs + a chart + the province table teaser in one frame.

WORKFLOW:
- Spawn 3 parallel subagents on this SAME task: Perencana/Riset (verify all Indonesia statistics + sources, rank the sections, hand the root a data table); Pelaksana/Aset & layout (design system + layout + chart specs); Peninjau/QA (gates: offline open from file://, zero network requests, 2-run byte-identical dossier, screenshot sizes/dimensions, caps, stdlib-only main.ts, README badges, LICENSE). Report each subagent by role when it starts and finishes. Each subagent ends its report with its agent_id.
- ONLY the root session writes entry files (app/, main.ts, screenshots/, README, LICENSE, makefun-run.json, serve.ts, shots.json). main.ts is written TWICE in separate messages with a real change between them (v2 adds a validation guard: refuse unless app/ exists, screenshots are PNG/JPEG <=256 KiB, dossier regenerates identically).
- Work dir: ~/workspace/best-national-statistics-site-v3/ (fresh git repo; do not touch any older stats dirs). vendor/makefun-frontend.ts and LICENSE may come from the FRESH kit starter at ~/.makefun/kits/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539/best-national-statistics-site-20261126-0539-kit/starter/ (kit RULES.txt sha 32eb75be, competition.yaml sha 5b7946ef). Do NOT read RULES.txt or competition.yaml as text — the card is the spec.
- Screenshots: capture with Playwright Chromium (~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1255/chrome-linux64/chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --screenshot=... --window-size=1440,900 --hide-scrollbars <file:// URL>). System Chrome fails with the Hatch WebGL domain policy; use Playwright Chromium. 4 shots: 1-cover (desktop hero), 2-charts, 3-provinces, 4-phone (390x844).
- Verify by running main.ts yourself twice (MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/ns-out1, /tmp/ns-out2) and diffing; verify the dossier is byte-identical and every gate above holds. Then report to the orchestrator: every file + sha256, dossier bytes + sha256, app/ file count + bytes, screenshot names + sizes, your agent_id, and confirmation of the 2-run check.
- Builder deadline ~22:15 WIB. This brief is the run record: save it verbatim as makefun-run.json.
